ideas.pitch: An automated head-to-head algorithmic battle arena that matches students of similar ICPC ratings to solve localized competitive programming questions under tight time limits.
ideas.title: AlgoDuellist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the core spirit of Code-Clash, this tool solves a problem the judges and participants feel directly: the need for efficient, automated competitive programming practice environments.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight execution sandbox analyzer that helps C, C++, Java, and Python coders spot time-limit and memory-limit bottlenecks in their algorithms before submitting.
ideas.title: CodeJudge Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to the algorithmic optimization focus of ICPC-style contests where performance under strict time constraints is critical.

ideas.pitch: An algorithmic visualizer tailored for C++ and Java standard template libraries to trace graph traversals and dynamic programming matrix states in real-time.
ideas.title: CP-Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a practical, highly technical aid for students practicing complex algorithmic problem-solving.

ideas.pitch: A static code analysis plugin for Python and C++ solutions that estimates Big-O time and space complexity instantly during competitive coding sprints.
ideas.title: ComplexityMeter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate pain point for competitive programmers racing against the clock in 3-hour contests.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined multi-editor workspace designed for 2-3 member teams sharing a single lab computer during time-constrained programming contests.
ideas.title: TeamSync Lab
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific hardware constraint of the hackathon where teams must share a single computer terminal.
